summary: ToolBit values are now stored and displayed in the bit's own Units at a fixed tool precision (3 decimals metric, 4 imperial) independent of the units schema and decimals preference, shipped .fctb bits declare a Units parameter, and the ToolBit task panel is repaired so a tool in a document can be edited by double-click.

pages.reason: Path/Tool/toolbit/util.py quantity_to_str: parameters saved in the bit's Units at 3/4 decimals rather than UserString; Tools/Bit/*.fctb gain a "Units" parameter; docobject/ui/property.py at_tool_precision: editor fields show tool precision not the decimals preference; toolbit/ui/view.py doubleClicked -> setEdit and panel.py fix make the in-document task panel reachable
Path/Tool/toolbit/util.py format_value: list entries now read e.g. '5.000 mm 4-flute endmill, 30.000 mm cutting edge' (TestPathToolBitListWidget), text otherwise unchanged
Path/Tool/shape/models/base.py _normalize_value: bare numbers pick up mm/deg; internal fix restoring documented parameter units, nothing on the page changes

meta.title: CAM: Fix ToolBit units, precision and the task panel
